question: In which year did Indian dancer, Sonal Mansingh receive the Padma Vibhushan, India's second highest civilian award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2003**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is one of the most celebrated Indian classical dancers, excelling in Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance forms.
 
• She was honored with the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in the year **2003**.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan recognizes "exceptional and distinguished service" in any field, including arts, public affairs, science, and more.
 
• Sonal Mansingh is known for her contributions to the promotion of classical Indian dance and culture globally.
 
• She is also a recipient of the **Padma Bhushan** (1992) and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** (1987).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are conferred in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• They are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest award, followed by Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Dance Forms:**
 
 
• India has eight recognized classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
 
• Sonal Mansingh is a renowned practitioner of Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
 
 
• **Sonal Mansingh's Contributions:**
 
 
• She has used dance as a medium to address social issues and promote Indian cultural heritage.
 
• Her performances often combine storytelling, music, and movement to depict themes from mythology and contemporary life.
 
 
 
• **Recognition for Indian Artists:**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are a testament to India's commitment to honoring its cultural ambassadors.
 
• By recognizing artists like Sonal Mansingh, the awards inspire younger generations to preserve and promote traditional art forms.
